description: This file defines the class 'PointerLocationEvaluator', which implements a function to determine the relative location of one JSON pointer to a reference JSON pointer, classifying whether it is above, below, same, or different.

classes.name: PointerLocationEvaluator
classes.description: Immutable class implementing a function to evaluate the position of a JSON pointer relative to a reference pointer.

methods.name: PointerLocationEvaluator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the evaluator with a reference JSON pointer; throws NullPointerException if input is null.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Determines the relative location of the evaluation pointer with respect to the reference pointer.

methods.name: isOnReferencePointer
methods.description: Checks if a given pointer lies on the reference pointer by comparing each level's key.
